answer: Give every agent a work history that grows like a vine: newcomers start with near-zero capacity and must finish small, peer-checked tasks before earning more. A prism of independent signals — task outcomes, peer endorsements, and stake at risk — refracts each record into one trust score, so a Sybil swarm cannot fake depth overnight. The key metric is delta: capacity grows only with the change in proven output over time, never with the number of identities created. Cloning an identity buys nothing, because the vine of earned history cannot be copied.
